A heap-buffer-overflow in xmlParsePubidLiteral (parser.c): when parsing PublicID/external ID literals (via xmlParseExternalID/xmlParseEntityDecl), a buffer is resized/mis-sized leading to a one-byte write past the end of a heap allocation. This results in heap memory corruption that can cause crashes and may be exploitable for further attacks (e.g., arbitrary code execution).
